query: UPDATE job_item AS ji SET state = 'parked_live', blocked_on = $3, park_expires_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE ji.org_id = $1 AND ji.job_id = $2 AND ji.state IN ('leased', 'running', 'verifying') AND (ji.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR ji.lease_expires_at <= now()) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM write_attempt wa WHERE wa.org_id = ji.org_id AND wa.job_item_id = ji.id AND wa.state IN ('in_flight', 'ambiguous', 'committed') AND wa.lease_epoch = ji.lease_epoch)
